parsed.post: Kept warmup 0.1 at batch 262k: 0.9440 -> 0.9140. Big caveat: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so val_bpb may be contaminated. Next: same warmup with clean TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to get a trustworthy number.
